check: All work items, before the helpdesk filter

sql_query: SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket;
SELECT count(*) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket AND is_open_backlog;
SELECT round(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY resolution_hours)::numeric, 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket AND is_resolved AND in_system_period;
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE is_high_severity) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority_known), 0), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket;

check: Reopen rate %, all years (as on the card)
sql_query: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE was_reopened) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket;
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE was_reopened) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket AND in_system_period;

SELECT round(100.0 * (count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2022-01' AND '2022-12') - count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2021-01' AND '2021-12')) / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2021-01' AND '2021-12'), 0), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket;
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE issue_type = 'Ticket') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket;
SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE priority = 'Medium') / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket AND priority_known;

SELECT round(100.0 * (1.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2022-01' AND '2022-12') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2016-01' AND '2016-12'), 0) - 1), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket;

SELECT round(100.0 * (1.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2020-01' AND '2020-12') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_month BETWEEN '2016-01' AND '2016-12'), 0) - 1), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket;

check: Open tickets at least 30 days old % (shown as 57%)
sql_query: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE age_days_at_extract >= 30) / NULLIF(count(*), 0), 1) FROM analytics.fact_ticket WHERE is_helpdesk_ticket AND is_open_backlog;
